Karnataka to officially celebrate Engineers Day, allow 'Er.' prefix

The Karnataka government has decided to officially celebrate Engineers Day as a state event starting next year. Additionally, engineers in the state will be permitted to use the prefix 'Er.' before their names. This decision was announced by the government.
